summary: Glucotrack filed an 8-K/A on July 29, 2026 to amend a prior 8-K dated July 27, 2026, updating and replacing the original Exchange Agreement with a new Exchange Agreement with an investor. The new agreement partitions a $900,000 promissory note from an existing original note, reducing the original note's balance. The investor may exchange all or part of the partitioned note for shares of common stock. This is a debt-for-equity exchange mechanism, not a standard acquisition, tender, or capital return event. The filing details a material agreement but does not constitute a classic special situation broadly recognized by investors. Monitor for potential dilution if the investor exchanges the note into equity.
